title: 第13章 此药对男女皆有奇效第14章 劫药也劫人
lines: “逃得了吗？”
三刀把头却根本不怕张天雪逃走。
这几天，他早已对这车队的实力打探清楚，张长利就是此行最大的隐患，有千钧境九重的实力！
但现在已经被斩杀。
虽然还有几个千钧境的供奉，但昨日他已经在酒水中下了毒，现在正是毒发的时候，不足为虑。
至于剩下的死士、护卫，这些人，哪里够看？不过是砍瓜切菜罢了！
这一票已然得手！
三刀把头狞笑着，手握三刀，斩杀那几名死士，便急速追了上去。
喊杀声不断响起，山贼死了不少，但九鼎商会的人死了更多，最后更是被全数斩杀！
而张天雪也没能逃走，被三刀把头追上，擒拿了下来。
“三刀把头，这次可真是全靠你了，按照约定你可以拿走三分之一！”
四个山寨的大当家聚在一起。
他们都是哈哈大笑，毕竟这次收获巨大，各种灵宝、材料、金币、丹药，琳琅满目，其中甚至还有五品疗伤丹，更是难得的好东西！
“这个女人你们谁要？”
三刀把头呵呵一笑。
而看到张天雪，四个大当家都是眼前一亮，有的甚至呼吸粗重起来，已经开始咽口水。
张天雪的确极美，身材修长，该有弧度的地方绝没有半点含糊，凹凸有致。
加上那赛雪的肌肤，吹弹可破一般，容貌绝丽，让人难以移开眼睛。
尤其是她身上带着的贵气，就更是让这些山贼发狂了！
他们都是粗鄙的人，哪里见过这样的尊贵小姐，自然全都想要！
“这样的女人可不多，大魏都没有几个，玩一次，死都值了，没有五品以上的刀法武技可不换！”
三刀把头道。
五品！
妈的，这三刀把头还真敢开口！
不过为这样一个女人，值了！
毕竟张天雪这样的高贵小姐，到了外面，就是拿着六品珍宝都不可能得到！
“你们放了我，我可以给你们每个人一门五品武技！”
张天雪银牙紧咬，想要反抗，却没有力气。
她的玄力被三刀把头封住了，此刻连想要自杀都做不到。
只是闻言，一众山贼都是大笑起来。
九鼎商会自然有这样的财力，但那也要有命拿才行，他们当然不会蠢到放张天雪回去。
“这是五品武技阿鼻刀，够了吧？”
其中一个山寨的大当家将一道卷轴递给三刀把头。
五品武技珍贵得很，的确令人肉疼。
而看到有人出手，另外三人有些犹豫，五品武技他们倒也有，但必须是刀法，这就有些难寻了。
想了想最后还是算了。
说到底只是一个女人而已，有了钱，自然有的是女人可以玩。
而且以后玩腻了，说不定就便宜卖给他们，到时候还能捞个勤俭持家的美名。
如此，各家分赃，一切妥当之后就匆匆往山寨赶去。
他们必须尽快撤离！
张天雪被王老九扛在肩膀上，无声落泪，她心中恐惧无比，不断呐喊着，希望有人可以来救她。
但又有谁会来救她？
这些山贼狡猾，做完这一票必定远遁，谁都找不到他们。
而她将暗无天日的活着，成为山贼泄欲的工具，被蹂躏践踏！
一念及此，张天雪就是心若死灰。
content_en:
"Can you escape?"
The leader of the three swordsmen was not afraid of Zhang Tianxue escaping at all.
In the past few days, he has already found out the strength of this team. Zhang Changli is the biggest hidden danger in this trip, with the strength of the ninth level of Qianjun Realm!
But now he has been killed.
Although there are still a few Qianjun Realm enshrinements, he had already poisoned the wine yesterday, and now is the time when the poison is taking effect, so there is nothing to worry about.
As for the remaining dead soldiers and guards, where can we see enough of these people? It’s just chopping melons and vegetables!
This vote has been won!
The leader of the Three Swordsman smiled ferociously, holding three swords in his hand, beheading the dead soldiers, and then quickly chased after them.
The shouts of killing continued. Many bandits died, but more people from the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce died. In the end, they were all killed!
Zhang Tianxue was unable to escape either, and was caught up with San Dao and captured.
"The leader of the three swords, this time it really depends on you. According to the agreement, you can take one third!"
The bosses of the four cottages gathered together.
They all laughed. After all, the harvest this time was huge. There were all kinds of spiritual treasures, materials, gold coins, and elixirs. There was even a fifth-grade healing elixir, which was a rare good thing!
"Which of you wants this woman?"
The head of Sandao chuckled.
When they saw Zhang Tianxue, the four heads' eyes lit up, and some even started breathing heavily and started to swallow their saliva.
Zhang Tianxue is indeed very beautiful, with a slender figure, and there is absolutely no ambiguity in the places where there should be curvature, and the bumps and convexities are regular.
Coupled with Sai Xue's skin, which can be broken by a blow, her appearance is so beautiful that it is difficult to take your eyes away.
Especially the nobility she carried made these bandits crazy!
They are all vulgar people. They have never seen such a distinguished lady, so naturally they want them all!
"There are not many women like this, even in the Great Wei Dynasty. If you play once, it's worth dying. If you don't have swordsmanship and martial arts skills above the fifth level, you can't do it!"
San Dao said.
Fifth grade!
Damn, these three swordsmen really dare to speak!
But for such a woman, it’s worth it!
After all, it is impossible for a noble lady like Zhang Tianxue to get a sixth-grade treasure outside!
"If you let me go, I can give each of you a fifth-grade martial arts!"
Zhang Tianxue gritted her teeth and wanted to resist, but she had no strength.
Her profound energy was blocked by three swords, and she couldn't even commit suicide at this moment.
Just hearing this, all the bandits burst into laughter.
The Jiuding Chamber of Commerce naturally has such financial resources, but it must be done with a life. Of course, they will not be stupid enough to let Zhang Tianxue go back.
"This is the fifth-grade martial art Abi Dao. Is it enough?"
The boss of one of the cottages handed a scroll to the head of the three swordsmen.
Fifth-grade martial arts are very precious, and it is indeed painful.
When they saw someone taking action, the other three were a little hesitant. They did have fifth-grade martial arts, but they had to be sword skills, which was a bit difficult to find.
After thinking about it for a while, I finally gave it up.
After all, she is just a woman. With money, there are naturally many women to play with.
And when you get tired of playing with it later, you might sell it to them cheaply, and then you can gain a reputation as a thrifty and thrifty person.
In this way, each family divided the spoils, and after everything was settled, they hurried to the village.
They must evacuate as soon as possible!
Zhang Tianxue was carried on Wang Laojiu's shoulders and cried silently. She was extremely frightened and kept shouting, hoping that someone could come to save her.
But who will come to save her?
These bandits are cunning, and they will definitely run away after doing this, and no one can find them.
And she will live in darkness, become a tool for bandits to vent their lust, and be ravaged and trampled on!
When Zhang Tianxue thought of this, his heart was filled with despair.
